title: Indígenas y afrodescendientes
goal: Read about two very different colonial legal frameworks: a paternalistic 'legal minor' doctrine for indigenous people, and free Black militias and an escaped-slave town still standing today.

items: Explain how colonial law classified indigenous people and what that implied.
Describe the mobility path many free Afro-descendant men pursued.
Describe what San Basilio de Palenque is and why it's notable.
Explain why neither group fits a single simple category.
